startup.splash: PMM.exe owns the immediate native startup splash and closes it only after the editable UI reports startup:UI-shell-ready:<HWND>; the Host then transfers foreground ownership to that HWND before destroying the splash.

ui.legacy_full_ui: PowerShell/WPF temporary regression path on FullLanguage systems
ui.native_shell: Win32 shell used when FullLanguage is unavailable or when ui-native is requested
ui.editable_workspace_process: On FullLanguage systems the external XAML/PowerShell workspace remains out-of-process for editability. It is launched with CREATE_NO_WINDOW but not SW_HIDE, sets AppUserModelID laredson.PalworldManagerMerger before creating its top-level window, and reports its HWND to PMM.exe for an atomic splash/taskbar/foreground handoff.
